meta.description: Shows a time-aware “你好，腾盛” speech bubble near the bottom-right corner of the window, just above the message composer (morning/noon/afternoon/evening variants), plus the signed-in DeepSeek account balance refreshed every 60 seconds. A balance below 3 CNY is flagged. Click the balance line to expand details: account, connection state with a one-click reconnect, today's spend estimate (balance delta, ignoring top-ups; spending before the plugin was installed cannot be counted, and the baseline time is shown), top-up balance, last update, and shortcuts to the Platform usage/top-up pages; a privacy toggle hides amounts, and drag remembers the bubble position. Click × to dismiss it; it appears again on the next page load. Control labels are localized; the greeting stays Chinese. Balance is read through the DSH account service, so the browser never sees the account token; a signed-out or failed read shows “--”. The plugin makes no network requests of its own and collects no data. Disable or remove the bundle under Plugins to remove it.
